title: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A young former Imperial samurai trainee working as a Hyozan Reckoner to find the missing emperor; after bonding with Himoto he becomes a planeswalker.

entities.name: Eiko Shizuki
entities.description: Kaito's sister, an Imperial student training to be a Kami Diplomat, who helps him in Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: The leader of the Hyozan Reckoners, who sends Kaito after Tameshi's research.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: A young moonfolk Futurist prodigy who is prototyping a way to connect kami and technology.

entities.name: Nari
entities.description: A Hyozan Reckoner with needle-tipped metal gloves and an expertise in poisons.

entities.name: Satoru's channeler
entities.description: A gray-skinned woman who channels Azamaki and serves Satoru; this page does not name her.

entities.name: Himoto
aliases: Himoto, the Kami of the Spark
entities.description: A rare tanuki-shaped kami born in the mortal realm, embodying the emperor's bond with Kyodai; she bonds with Kaito and makes him a planeswalker.

entities.name: Gravelighter
entities.description: A territorial kami of Jukai Forest with a stone face and a paper lantern, who attacks the group before Himoto commands her to retreat.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The great ancient kami of the Eiganjo temple who speaks telepathically to the emperor; her voice is heard in the forest.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: Kaito and Eiko's mentor, who did not believe their accounts of the night the emperor vanished.

entities.name: Katsumasa
entities.description: A moonfolk Kaito met in the Imperial gardens years ago, who gave him the crane drone and was Tameshi's mentor.

entities.name: Azamaki
aliases: Azamaki, the Kami of Treachery Incarnate
entities.description: A kami of treachery that Satoru's channeler allows to possess her.

entities.name: The Emperor of Kamigawa
entities.description: Kaito's best friend, who went missing a year ago from Kyodai's temple.

entities.name: Kodama of the West Tree
entities.description: A towering tree kami who lets Eiko and Kaito pass along the border of Jukai Forest as long as they do not cross the river.

entities.name: Kami of Exultant Revelry
entities.description: A kami blazing across the rooftops during the Lantern Festival.

entities.name: Kami of Empty Graves
entities.description: A kami of Jukai Forest that Kaito would prefer not to meet at night.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: A criminal gang of the Undercity led by Satoru, whose members bear loyalty tattoos.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: Kami channelers who revere the spirits and guard Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Futurists
entities.description: Technologists of Otawara whom the Imperials blamed for the attack on the emperor.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The rulers of Kamigawa centered on the palace in Eiganjo.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where technology and spirit realm are merging.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: The city of Kamigawa that hosts the Lantern Festival and the Undercity.

entities.name: The Undercity
entities.description: The shadowed district of Towashi where Satoru's den lies.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: The floating Futurist city of metal and glass.

entities.name: Boseiju District
entities.description: The kami-filled forest district, home to the Order of Jukai, with a merge gate.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: The forest where Tameshi hides his makeshift laboratory.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: The home of the Imperial Palace where Kaito and Eiko grew up.

entities.name: Lantern Festival
entities.description: A festival in Towashi beloved by night-loving spirits.

entities.name: The Merge
entities.description: The ongoing merging of the mortal and spirit realms, with merge gates.

entities.name: Tanuki prototype
entities.description: A metal tanuki drone built by Tameshi that Himoto bonds with and that becomes Kaito's mask.

events.summary: Kaito stalks a gambler through the crowded Lantern Festival for a Reckoner job.
events.quote: It hadn't taken Kaito long to find his target.

events.summary: Kaito reflects that it has been a year since the emperor went missing, the night he chased a stranger out of Kyodai's temple.
events.quote: It had only been a year since the emperor went missing.

events.summary: Kaito picks the gambler's pocket and clears the job on his comm.
events.quote: Kaito reached into the man's coat and retrieved his wallet.

events.summary: In the Undercity a Reckoner accuses Kaito of stealing his mark, and Kaito talks him down.
events.quote: "You stole my mark."

events.summary: Kaito reveals he joined the Reckoners to find the man with a metal arm who attacked the emperor.
events.quote: If anyone was going to know about a man with a metal arm, it would be Satoru's spies.

events.summary: Satoru's channeler, possessed by Azamaki, summons Kaito to see Satoru.
events.quote: "Satoru wishes to speak with you,"

events.summary: Satoru questions Kaito's loyalty, noting he has no loyalty mark.
events.quote: "Yet you have no loyalty mark."

events.summary: Satoru assigns Kaito an off-list job: steal the schematics of the moonfolk Futurist Tameshi.
events.quote: I want you to bring me the schematics.

events.summary: Kaito learns Tameshi has moved his research to the Boseiju District and enlists his sister Eiko as a diplomat to guide him.
events.quote: Kaito lifted his head to find his sister standing several feet away.

events.summary: Eiko sets rules, including no weapons, and Kaito explains he is working for the Reckoners for the emperor's sake.
events.quote: "I'm doing this for the emperor,"

events.summary: Eiko speaks with the Kodama of the West Tree and gains safe passage but conceals the threat of Tameshi.
events.quote: "She says we can pass through safely, as long as we don't go beyond the river,"

events.summary: Kaito draws his dagger at a rock kami and Eiko scolds him for breaking the no-weapons rule.
events.quote: "I thought we agreed no weapons,"

events.summary: Eiko confesses she saw a light on the roof the night the emperor vanished, which exploded and became an animal.
events.quote: It wasn't a man—it was a light.

events.summary: Kaito and Eiko reconcile over Light-Paws's disbelief, and Eiko offers to bring him home.
events.quote: "You can still come home, you know.

events.summary: Eiko turns back at the river, and Kaito crosses alone and finds Tameshi's makeshift laboratory with a caged something.
events.quote: Not a box—a cage . And there was something trapped inside.

events.summary: Tameshi ambushes Kaito and they fight with Tameshi's origami staff; Kaito pins Tameshi's throat with the staff.
events.quote: until he managed to pull the rod against his opponent's throat.

events.summary: Eiko stops Kaito from strangling Tameshi.
events.quote: "Kaito, what are you doing? Let him go!"

events.summary: Tameshi recognizes Kaito's crane drone and reveals that Katsumasa was his mentor and that they designed it together.
events.quote: "He was my mentor.

events.summary: The caged object turns out to be a metal tanuki robot, which Eiko recognizes as resembling the animal she saw.
events.quote: "This robot is almost identical to the animal I saw."

events.summary: Tameshi explains the light was a unique kami being born, embodying the emperor's bond with Kyodai, and that he built the prototype to protect it.
events.quote: "The light you saw was a kami being born.

events.summary: Kaito hears Kyodai's voice and runs after it hoping the emperor has returned, but finds only the tanuki-shaped kami.
events.quote: Instead, he saw the tanuki-shaped kami, with glowing white eyes and translucent fur.

events.summary: Eiko and Tameshi argue over whether his research endangers the kami and the merge gates, and Eiko demands it be destroyed.
events.quote: "Your research—it needs to be destroyed."

events.summary: Five Hyozan Reckoners led by Nari arrive with Satoru's channeler, revealing they were watching Kaito and that the job was a setup to find Tameshi.
events.quote: He hoped you'd lead us to Tameshi."

events.summary: A Reckoner seizes Eiko at swordpoint and Nari demands the kami.
events.quote: One of the Reckoners moved quickly, grabbing hold of Eiko and holding a sword against her neck.

events.summary: Eiko breaks free and the siblings fight the Reckoners back to back while Tameshi fails to make the kami merge with the robot.
events.quote: "What happened to 'no weapons'?"

events.summary: The Order of Jukai arrives and battles the Reckoners, letting the group escape with the kami.
events.quote: The Order of Jukai had arrived.

events.summary: Gravelighter attacks the fleeing group; Kaito shields Eiko and Himoto, and Himoto commands Gravelighter to retreat.
events.quote: No—not a cry. A command .

events.summary: Tameshi reveals he stalled and sent a drone to summon the Order of Jukai, and Eiko offers him a deal to abandon the research.
events.quote: I was stalling, waiting for the Order of Jukai to turn up.

events.summary: Tameshi gives Kaito his tanuki drone and departs to clear his lab.
events.quote: "Take it. It's far better than that outdated crane you've been holding onto."

events.summary: Himoto refuses to go to the palace with Eiko; Kaito names her Pompon-chan and vows to find the emperor.
events.quote: "I vote we call her Pompon-chan for now,"

events.summary: Himoto bonds with the tanuki prototype and tells Kaito her name.
events.quote: "She says her name is Himoto."

events.summary: Kaito dons the tanuki mask and feels a surge of power, and Kaito vanishes from Kamigawa as a new planeswalker.
events.quote: Kaito took a step forward and vanished from Kamigawa.

events.summary: Kaito, now a planeswalker, returns to Towashi in his mask, resolved to keep searching the Multiverse for the emperor.
events.quote: There were many more planes to search.
